title: Foreseeable · adj.
subtitle: 「可預見的／可預測的／預期中的」，究竟是哪一種 foreseeable？
description: 「可預見的／可預測的／預期中的」，究竟是哪一種 foreseeable？

words.note: 使用者提供。predictable 是 foreseeable 最直接的近義詞之一，表示根據已有模式、證據或規律，可以合理預測某結果或事件。它比 expected 更強調『可從規律推知』。
words.example: The delay was predictable given the severe weather.

exercises.original: The traffic problems were foreseeable because the main road was closed.
exercises.zh: 由於主要道路封閉，交通問題是可以預見的。
exercises.upgrade: predictable · 可預測的；可預見的

options.explanation: road closure provides a clear causal basis for predicting congestion.
常用於已被視為正常或很可能發生的結果，尤其是 planning/budgeting 語境。 本題的決定性線索是 a clear cause makes the outcome predictable；這裡需要的是「可由規律／證據預測」。因此 expected 雖與 foreseeable 有重疊，但是否基於規律、是否已納入規劃、是否由模型推算或是否只是機率較高並不最吻合。
常表示事先已想到，且常因此預作準備。 本題的決定性線索是 a clear cause makes the outcome predictable；這裡需要的是「可由規律／證據預測」。因此 anticipated 雖與 foreseeable 有重疊，但是否基於規律、是否已納入規劃、是否由模型推算或是否只是機率較高並不最吻合。
常與 population, revenue, costs, demand 等數據／模型預測搭配。 本題的決定性線索是 a clear cause makes the outcome predictable；這裡需要的是「可由規律／證據預測」。因此 projected 雖與 foreseeable 有重疊，但是否基於規律、是否已納入規劃、是否由模型推算或是否只是機率較高並不最吻合。
直接表示發生機率高，重點是 probability，而不是是否可預見。 本題的決定性線索是 a clear cause makes the outcome predictable；這裡需要的是「可由規律／證據預測」。因此 likely 雖與 foreseeable 有重疊，但是否基於規律、是否已納入規劃、是否由模型推算或是否只是機率較高並不最吻合。

words.note: 使用者提供。expected 表示某事被認為很可能發生，或符合原先預期。它比 predictable 更偏 expectation，而不一定要求有明顯規律。
words.example: The expected increase in costs was included in the budget.

exercises.original: The foreseeable increase in costs has already been included in the budget.
exercises.zh: 預期中的成本增加已經計入預算。

options.explanation: being included in the budget shows the increase was already anticipated as likely.

words.meaning: 事先預料的；預先想到的
words.note: anticipated 強調某人或某機構在事情發生前已經想到、預料或為其作準備。它比 expected 多一層 deliberate forethought。
words.example: The anticipated rise in demand led the company to increase production.

exercises.original: The foreseeable increase in visitors led the museum to hire extra staff.
exercises.zh: 由於事先預料到訪客增加，博物館增聘了員工。

words.example: The projected population growth will require more housing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者非常接近；predictable 更常突出可由模式、證據或因果關係推知。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The traffic jam was predictable. The risk was foreseeable.

falseSynonyms.zh: expected 表示已被認為很可能發生；foreseeable 只要求可以合理預見，不一定真的有人預期它會發生。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The expected cost increase was budgeted for. The accident was a foreseeable consequence.

falseSynonyms.zh: anticipated 常暗示事先已想到，甚至已作準備；foreseeable 不要求有人真的採取準備。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The anticipated rise led us to hire staff. The risk was foreseeable but ignored.

falseSynonyms.zh: likely 是『很可能』；foreseeable 是『可以合理預見』。有些低機率風險仍可 foreseeable。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Rain is likely tomorrow. The legal risk was foreseeable.

falseSynonyms.zh: inevitable 表示不可避免；foreseeable 只表示可預見，完全不等於一定發生。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Some delay was foreseeable. Complete failure was not inevitable.

falseSynonyms.zh: possible 只表示有可能；foreseeable 需要有合理基礎可提前預見。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A delay is possible. The delay was foreseeable from the warning signs.

falseSynonyms.zh: imaginable 只要能想像即可，範圍遠廣於可合理預見。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Almost any scenario is imaginable. Only some risks are reasonably foreseeable.

falseSynonyms.zh: foreseeable 是形容詞，表示『可以被預見』；foreseen 是 foresee 的過去分詞，表示『已經被預見』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The problem was foreseeable. The problem had been foreseen.
